resources.string: 🎥 Kill the preview — the screen heats up as much as the encoder
📉 Lower \"Max bitrate\" — the encoder will thank you
Live thermometer for your phone. Still cool? Stream away, don\'t overthink it 😎\n\nStarts heating up? The color drifts toward red, and cooldown tip buttons show up below.

How the phone rates its own heat, from "chillin'" to "emergency". Starting at "getting toasty" the system already throttles clock speeds on its own — frames may start dropping.

What to do when it heats up:
• turn off the screen preview (camera panel)
• lower "Max bitrate" (stats panel)
• dim the screen with the buttons below
• take off the case, get out of the sun

Heat headroom: how close the phone is to throttling. 0% — cool and confident, 100% — already at the limit and cutting performance.

What to do if it's climbing:
• drop the preview and extra brightness
• lower bitrate or resolution/fps
• let the phone catch its breath (shade, airflow)

Battery temperature — the most honest thermometer for the case. Up to ~40°C is normal, by 45°C it's already hot, above that the phone starts saving itself.

What to do if it's high:
• stop charging on the move (power banks run hot)
• drop the preview and ease off the bitrate
• air out the case, take it off
